create_task_pipeline: create a Task for a pipeline partition with optional activation checkpointing based on chunk id
run_async_event_loop: run the AsyncEventLoop event loop to process microbatches across pipeline parallel stages
send_async_activations: send activation tensors asynchronously to the next pipeline stage using AutogradWithoutActivations
perform_backward_invocation: perform the backward pass for a pipeline invocation by looking up saved activations and calling backward
wrap_module_for_pipeline: wrap an nn.Sequential module with ModuleWrapper including its location and invocation metadata
